title: The ${\rm SL}(2,\mathbb{C})$-character variety of the magic $3$-manifold
summary: We determine the irreducible ${\rm SL}(2,\mathbb{C})$-character variety of the 3-chain link exterior which is called the `magic $3$-manifold', and deduce a formula for the twisted Alexander polynomial associated to each ${\rm SL}(2,\mathbb{C})$-representation.
